title: Forming a Paris band with Bill Coleman
summary: With Zutty and the pianist gone, Waters and Coleman rehearsed a new band of French and Martinique musicians in Paris for a French tour.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: No, no, not that great, see. So anyway, Zutty left too not long after that. But Dicky left before, I took Dicky's place, see. And Zutty stayed around for a while, see, then Zutty left, see. Then we toured and then went from there to France, but not to work, we went there for a rehearsal. And most of the group - Zutty wasn't there and the piano

player didn't make it. And that left just Bill and I, and we had to form a band in Paris, of Paris musicians and the French musicians, you know, so we had a Martinique bass player. So we rehearsed to make a French tour, we rehearsed for about two weeks, you know. And I was in Paris, I mean I was living, and [ ] was living in the same hotel where, you know, was living.
